meta.name: syUSD Katana: make requestOnChainWithdraw public
meta.description: setPublicCapability(queue, requestOnChainWithdraw.selector, true) on the syUSD Katana RolesAuthority so users can request vbUSDC withdrawals on Katana (matches Ethereum). vbUSDC is already a registered withdraw asset and is priceable by the accountant.
